text: Fourteen eighty-three. Two princes walk into the Tower of London. They never walk out.
sub: 1483: two princes enter the Tower. *They never leave.*
asr: 1483, two princes walk into the Tower of London. They never walk out.

text: Exhibit one. Edward, twelve, was about to be crowned king.
sub: Edward, 12, was about to be *crowned king*
asr: Exhibit one. Edward, 12, was about to be crowned king.

text: Exhibit two. Their uncle took the crown instead.
Exhibit three. In sixteen seventy-four, two small skeletons turned up under a staircase.
asr: Exhibit three. In 1674, two small skeletons turned up under a staircase.

text: Who did it? Their uncle, Richard the Third? Henry Tudor? Or did they escape?
